spec.doc: Runs atomically at deploy time, so nobody can front-run initialization. `protocol_fee_share_bps` is the default protocol/LP split for new markets; 10_000 keeps the whole fee with the protocol (pre-upgrade behaviour). Pass 0 to give all fees to the market creators.
spec.name: __constructor

spec.doc: The market's snapshotted breakers (`None` for legacy markets created before breakers existed — those are never checked).
spec.name: breaker_config

spec.doc: The current ledger's band reference, if a band check has run this ledger. `None` means the next trade sets the reference (to its own pre-trade price, which equals the ledger-open price).
spec.name: breaker_state

spec.doc: Spend `collateral_in` to buy `outcome` shares. Returns shares received. Reverts if fewer than `min_shares_out` would be received. Legacy entrypoint: no deadline and no limit price, so a signed bound can execute at any later time. Prefer `buy_v2`.
spec.name: buy

spec.doc: `buy` plus a deadline (`env.ledger().timestamp()` seconds — network time, not the client clock) and an average-price limit (`limit_price_bps` per share, 1.0 = BPS; 0 = no limit). The average price includes the fee (`fee` is part of `collateral_in`) and, for a NO buy, is compared against the NO price. Because the deadline check runs before `require_auth`, an expired transaction fails cheaply. A limit above BPS can never pass for a buy and is rejected as invalid.
spec.name: buy_v2

spec.doc: The creator (the LP) claims their share of accrued trade fees at any time, including before finality. Returns the amount claimed (0 when nothing is pending, mirroring `sweep_fees`).
spec.name: claim_lp_fees

spec.doc: Creator (the LP) withdraws whatever the pool still holds once final, plus any unclaimed LP fees. Returns the total paid out.
spec.name: claim_pool_remainder

spec.doc: Creates a market and seeds the pool. `creator` becomes the sole LP. `initial_yes_bps` in [100, 9900] sets the opening YES probability; the creator receives the leftover shares of the likelier outcome.
spec.name: create_market

spec.doc: Spot price of `outcome` in bps (0..=10_000). YES + NO ~ 10_000.
spec.name: get_price

spec.doc: The pending admin proposal, including its expiry, if one exists.
spec.name: pending_admin

spec.doc: Starts a two-step handover of the admin role. The new admin must call `accept_admin` itself, so a typo cannot hand control to an address nobody holds.
spec.name: propose_admin

spec.doc: Affects markets created after the call and the legacy fallback in `sweep_fees`. Markets with a snapshotted `FeeTerms` keep paying their original recipient.
spec.name: propose_treasury

spec.doc: Shares a `buy` of `collateral_in` would return right now.
spec.name: quote_buy

spec.doc: Shares a `sell` for exactly `collateral_out` would consume right now.
spec.name: quote_sell

spec.doc: Pays out `holder`'s position for a final market and clears it. Losing positions clear with a payout of 0.
spec.name: redeem

spec.doc: Receive exactly `collateral_out` by selling `outcome` shares. Returns shares sold. Reverts if more than `max_shares_in` would be needed. Clients turn "sell N shares" into `collateral_out` off-chain (see `math::calc_sell` docs) and add a slippage margin to `max_shares_in`. Legacy entrypoint: no deadline and no limit price. Prefer `sell_v2`.
spec.name: sell

spec.doc: `sell` plus a deadline (ledger timestamp, seconds) and a minimum average execution price (`limit_price_bps` per share, 1.0 = BPS). A zero limit is trivially satisfied for sells — unlike buys, where 0 means "no limit" — and a limit above BPS can never pass, so neither needs a special case. The average includes the fee, which the trader pays out of the gross.
spec.name: sell_v2

spec.doc: Sets the breaker defaults copied into markets created after the call. `band_bps < max_impact_bps` (both non-zero) is rejected: a single trade that is allowed by the impact cap could then never fit inside the band, locking trading.
spec.name: set_default_breaker

spec.doc: Affects markets created after the call; existing markets keep their fee.
spec.name: set_default_fee_bps

spec.doc: Affects markets created after the call; existing markets keep the split they snapshotted at creation.
spec.name: set_protocol_fee_share_bps

spec.doc: Anyone can move accrued protocol fees to the market's fee recipient. Sends to the recipient snapshotted in `FeeTerms` at creation. Markets created before `FeeTerms` existed have none and keep the legacy behaviour: the `DataKey::Treasury` of the moment of the sweep.
spec.name: sweep_fees

spec.doc: Transfers the single LP role (the right to `claim_pool_remainder` and `claim_lp_fees`) to `new_creator`. Only until the remainder has been claimed; after that the role has no remaining value.
spec.name: transfer_lp

spec.doc: Moves `amount` shares of `outcome` from `from` to `to`.
spec.name: transfer_position

spec.doc: Invalid or unresolvable market. Allowed any time before finality.
spec.name: void_market

spec.doc: True when a `buy` of `collateral_in` would be rejected by the market's breakers right now. Read-only: never writes band state, so on a fresh ledger the reference is taken as the current price — the same value a subsequent real trade would use.
spec.name: would_trip

spec.doc: Temporary (one ledger) band reference for a market.
spec.name: BandState

spec.doc: Per-market circuit breakers, snapshotted at creation from `DataKey::DefaultBreaker`. 0 disables each check. A market without a `Breaker` entry (created before breakers existed) is never checked.

fields.doc: Maximum |post-price - ledger-open price| cumulative movement in bps.
fields.name: band_bps

fields.doc: Maximum |post-price - pre-price| a single trade may move in bps.
fields.name: max_impact_bps

spec.name: BreakerConfig

spec.doc: Fee destination and split, snapshotted per market at creation as a side entry (`DataKey::FeeTerms`) so `Market`'s XDR shape never changes. Markets created before this entry existed have no `FeeTerms` and keep the legacy behaviour: `sweep_fees` pays whatever `DataKey::Treasury` holds at sweep time, with the protocol keeping 100% of the fee. That fallback is documented in `sweep_fees` and makes the upgrade migration-free.

fields.doc: Protocol's share of each trade fee in bps; the rest is the LP's. 0..=BPS. At BPS (the default) the split is exactly today's behaviour.
fields.name: protocol_share_bps

fields.doc: Where the protocol's fee share is swept. Frozen at creation: later `set_treasury` calls never redirect fees already earned.
fields.name: recipient

spec.name: FeeTerms

fields.doc: Unix seconds (ledger timestamp). Trading stops at this time.
fields.name: close_time

fields.doc: Snapshot of the fee at creation so later config changes never move it.
fields.name: fee_bps

fields.doc: Creator has withdrawn the pool remainder after finality.
fields.name: lp_claimed

fields.doc: IPFS CID / URI of the question metadata.
fields.name: meta_uri

fields.doc: sha256 of the canonical question JSON stored off-chain (IPFS), so a client can prove the text it shows is the text that was committed.
fields.name: question_hash

fields.doc: Commitment to how this market will be resolved, fixed at creation so the creator cannot pick favorable resolution rules after seeing trading activity. The resolver contract verifies a revealed spec against this hash before configuring itself for the market. See `docs/adr/0001-resolution-commitment.md`.
fields.name: resolution_hash

fields.doc: Complete sets in existence == collateral locked for this market.
fields.name: sets_minted

void_v0.doc: Trading allowed until `close_time`, then waiting for the resolver.
void_v0.name: Open

void_v0.doc: Invalid market. Every share redeems at 0.5.
void_v0.name: Void

spec.doc: A proposed admin handover (#62). Absent when no transfer is pending.
spec.name: PendingAdmin

cases.doc: `buy_v2` / `sell_v2` average execution price worse than the limit.
cases.name: LimitPriceExceeded

cases.doc: A proposed admin handover was not accepted within its `expires_at`.
cases.name: PendingAdminExpired

cases.doc: A single trade would move the price more than `max_impact_bps`. (Both this and the band reject the whole invocation, so their events, if any, roll back with it — see the note on `BreakerConfig`.)
cases.name: PriceImpactTooHigh

spec.doc: Same sweep as `FeesSwept` plus the actual recipient. New event rather than new fields so the existing `FeesSwept` XDR stays stable for indexers; both are emitted on every sweep.
spec.name: FeesSweptTo

params.doc: None means the market was voided.
params.name: outcome

params.doc: Pool remainder plus any LP fees drained in the same call.
params.name: payout

spec.doc: Positions moved between holders. Indexers that track balances from `Trade`/`Redeemed` must also apply this event (see docs/architecture.md).
spec.name: PositionTransferred
